* id : CHAR(36) NOT NULL [36 Bytes Clustered Primary Key Inode]

* actor_id : VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL [1-100 Bytes Principal Identifier]

HARDWARE, MEMORY & OUT-OF-BAND IMMUTABILITY POLICIES
1. Buffer Pool Optimization (innodb_buffer_pool_size = 256M):
Indexes uq_org_seq and chain_heads are locked resident in RAM. This provides sub-millisecond execution times for pessimistic write locks and eliminates disk I/O bottlenecks during peak transaction ingestion bursts.

2. Zero Page Splitting Overhead:
Because sequence numbers strictly increment by +1 (1, 2, 3...) per tenant, all B-Tree leaf insertions occur monotonically at the rightmost page node, ensuring 100% fill factor with zero index fragmentation or page splits.

3. Out-of-Band Hardware Immutability (AWS S3 Object Lock COMPLIANCE Mode):
Checkpoint digests are replicated directly to AWS S3 Object Lock buckets with Legal Hold ON, encrypted via dedicated AWS KMS Customer Managed Keys. S3 WORM hardware-level write protection rejects all database administrator (DBA) delete or overwrite operations.
